data.description: Brand New 2BR+Maid | Ready High Floor | Pool View
data.long_description:
Experience modern living in this spacious 2-bedroom apartment with a maid’s room in Equiti Home. Located on a high floor, this brand-new unit offers a peaceful pool view, bright interiors, and a smart layout ideal for both end-users and investors.

With a built-up area of 1,148.94 sqft, the apartment features generously sized bedrooms, a contemporary open kitchen, floor-to-ceiling windows, and a spacious living and dining area filled with natural light. The maid’s room adds extra convenience and flexibility for families.

Property Features:
• 2 Bedrooms + Maid’s Room
• Furnished
• High-Floor Unit
• Pool View
• Brand-New Apartment
• 1,148.94 sqft BUA
• Modern Finishes
• Spacious Balcony
• Built-in Wardrobes
• Covered Parking
• Ready to Move In

Building Amenities:
• Swimming Pool
• Fully Equipped Gym
• Kids Play Area
• 24/7 Security
• Close to Metro Station
• Easy Access to Sheikh Zayed Road

Located in the growing community of Al Furjan, this property offers excellent connectivity and a vibrant lifestyle with nearby retail, schools, and dining options.
